fomod.Name: Skyrim Loading Percent
fomod.Author: Parker Chace
fomod.Description: Adds a live loading animation and real-time progress bar to Skyrim Anniversary Edition and Skyrim VR loading screens. 20 hand-coded animations, fully configurable in-game via the SkyUI MCM. Requires SKSE64, Address Library, SkyUI, and MCM Helper. Skyrim SE 1.5.97 is not supported from 4.0.0 on; use 3.1.1 for that.
